newsitem.title: UK: Lebanon to launch 250 mln mark five-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon to launch 250 mln mark five-year bond.

text.p: Lebanon has mandated Commerzbank and Societe Generale to underwrite a 250 million mark five-year Eurobond, SocGen said on Thursday.
The terms and conditions for the issue would be determined in the coming weeks, it said.
Lebanon has tapped the international bond markets before, but only the dollar sector.
It issued a three-year dollar bond in 1994 and a five-year deal in 1995. The coupons on the deals were 10.125 percent and 9.125 percent respectively.
In March, Lebanon's acting finance minister Fouad Siniora said Lebanon wanted to issue mark bonds because interest rates were lower than in the dollar market.
